dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: Greetings. Please, this way for any certification regarding the festival.

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: Do you need anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is this place?

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: This is the Outlander Affairs Agency, which is under the jurisdiction of the Kanjou Commissioner.

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: What is it? Are you here to apply to stay in Ritou? Come in, then... and remember to keep your wallet at hand.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: Yes...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wallet?

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: Hmph, you'll see when you're in there...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What if I want to go to Narukami Island...

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: You want to go to Narukami Island? Then it's not something that can be taken care of with just Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: Even Inazuma locals must come here for approval if they want to go to Ritou, let alone an outlander such as yourself trying to leave it. You can forget it.

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: Unless you can get a Travel Permit, but it's not something that can be obtained so easily. Even I don't have a way to get it. As for you... good luck to you.

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: Can I help you with something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is this place?

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: This is the Outlander Affairs Agency, which is under the jurisdiction of the Kanjou Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: What is it? Are you here to apply to stay in Ritou?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What if I want to go to Narukami Island...

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: You want to go to Narukami Island? You need to apply for a Travel Permit first.

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: You've come at a good time.

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: Nowadays, the authorities are strict. As long as the required materials are ready, it should be much easier to apply than before.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: Is something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's this place?

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: This is the Outlander Affairs Agency, which is under the jurisdiction of the Kanjou Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: What is it? Do you need to apply for anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Apply?

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: Yes, that's right. You have to register here in order to do business, organize activities, send letters, and transport goods.

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: You've come at just the right time, really. As long as you have the required materials at the ready, it should be much easier to apply than before.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Chiba
dialogues.text: Mmm...
